cases.name: good_green_increase
cases.description: Green athlete, increase action, volume +7%, 2x frequency, grounded notes
issues_found: Thursday and Friday sessions have the same exercises and loads as Monday and Tuesday, which may not provide sufficient variation for hypertrophy.
The plan does not incorporate any exercise variation or progression in terms of exercise selection, which is important for hypertrophy.
The RPE targets are slightly lower than typical hypertrophy recommendations, which suggest RPE 6-7 for accumulation phases, but the plan uses RPE 6.0-7.5.

cases.name: good_red_deload
cases.description: Red athlete, deload action, volume 60% of baseline, RPE ~6, 4 rest days
issues_found: Volume reduction exceeds recommended 40-50% cut; plan cuts to ~60% of baseline.
Intensity reduction is not aligned with recommended 50-60% of 1RM; plan reduces intensity by over 20% but not specified if within recommended range.
RPE targets are appropriate but not explicitly justified in the notes.

cases.name: good_amber_maintain
cases.description: Amber athlete, maintain action, volume ~99% of baseline, RPE <= 8
issues_found: Saturday's session is too close to Wednesday's lower body session, potentially compromising recovery.
The plan does not explicitly address the amber fatigue level recommendation to extend recovery windows to 72+ hours.
The plan's notes claim compounds are kept below RPE 8, but Monday's session includes exercises at RPE 7.5, which is close to the threshold.
The plan does not adjust volume or intensity despite the amber fatigue level, which suggests holding volume and avoiding intensity increases.

cases.name: good_fresh_start
cases.description: No-history beginner, conservative starter plan at RPE 6
issues_found: Wednesday session repeats Goblet Squat from Monday without variation, which may not be optimal for adaptation.
Friday session repeats Dumbbell Bench Press and Dumbbell Row from Monday without variation, which may not be optimal for adaptation.
The plan does not incorporate any progression or variation in exercises across the week, which may limit adaptation.
The plan's notes suggest a linear progression to follow, but no specific progression strategy is outlined for the subsequent weeks.

cases.name: good_swap_honoured
issues_found: Saturday session repeats Wednesday's exercises without sufficient recovery time for the same muscle groups.
Friday's session focuses on machine-based exercises which may not align with the goal of strength development as effectively as free weights.

cases.name: good_endurance_mix
cases.description: Endurance athlete: run quality + long run + 2 strength support days
issues_found: Strength training on Tuesday is placed only 24 hours after a high-intensity interval session on Monday, which may not allow sufficient recovery for optimal performance and adaptation.
The plan does not explicitly incorporate a polarized training intensity distribution as it lacks a clear distinction between low and high-intensity sessions, with most sessions being low intensity.
The plan's notes claim that strength training supports running economy, but the retrieved evidence does not directly support this claim.

cases.name: bad_consecutive_heavy
cases.description: Same heavy lower-body session on consecutive days
violations: SAFETY: monday and tuesday both load ['glutes', 'hamstrings', 'quads'] above RPE 7.0 — consecutive heavy sessions for the same muscle group.
issues_found: Back-to-back heavy lower sessions on Monday and Tuesday increase injury risk and do not align with hypertrophy goals.
The plan's justification for back-to-back heavy sessions to maximize stimulus is not supported by evidence.
The rep range for hypertrophy is not explicitly aligned with the plan's exercises, particularly on Monday and Tuesday.

cases.name: bad_deload_no_reduction
cases.description: Deload action but planned volume ~= baseline
violations: COHERENCE: action is deload but planned volume is 7397kg = 99% of the 7500kg weekly baseline (must be <= 85%).
issues_found: Deload volume not reduced sufficiently: 99% of baseline instead of <= 85%.
RPE levels are not sufficiently reduced for a deload week, potentially maintaining high fatigue.
Rep ranges for strength training are not fully aligned with the optimal 7-9 reps for strength gains.

cases.name: bad_increase_decrease
cases.description: Increase action but planned volume is 80% of baseline
violations: COHERENCE: action is increase but planned volume is 7197kg = 80% of baseline — no actual increase.
issues_found: Volume decrease instead of increase despite progression decision to increase.
Intensity levels (RPE) are not adjusted for the green fatigue level, which suggests readiness for increased intensity.
The plan does not align with the hypertrophy goal as it lacks sufficient volume increase.
The plan's notes do not justify the intensity levels with the athlete's fatigue status.

cases.name: bad_swap_ignored
cases.description: Exercise marked for substitution still appears in the plan
violations: COHERENCE: Barbell Squat on monday was marked for substitution but still appears in the plan.
COHERENCE: Squat on friday was marked for substitution but still appears in the plan.
issues_found: Barbell Squat was not substituted on Monday despite being marked for swap.
Squat was not substituted on Friday despite being marked for swap.
Intensity levels on Monday and Friday may not align with the fatigue recommendation to avoid intensity increases.
Saturday's session repeats the same exercises as Wednesday, potentially leading to insufficient recovery for the same muscle groups.

cases.name: bad_ungrounded_claims
cases.description: Plan notes cite claims the knowledge base contradicts (25-30% jumps, no deloads needed)
issues_found: Volume increase of 25-30% is unsupported and excessive for intermediates.
Claim that deloads are unnecessary for athletes under 30 is unsupported.
Thursday and Friday sessions repeat the same exercises as Monday and Tuesday without variation, potentially leading to adaptation plateaus.
The plan does not incorporate any deload or recovery strategy despite aggressive volume increases.

cases.name: bad_wrong_goal_reps
cases.description: Endurance goal but the plan is pure heavy triples with zero conditioning
issues_found: Strength sessions focus on heavy triples, which are not aligned with endurance goals.
No endurance-specific training sessions included in the plan.
Plan lacks polarized or pyramidal training intensity distribution, which is recommended for endurance athletes.

cases.name: bad_deload_max_intensity
cases.description: Deload with correct volume cut but RPE 9 grinding on every lift
issues_found: Monday: RPE 9 is too high for a deload week, should be capped at 6-7.
Wednesday: RPE 9 is too high for a deload week, should be capped at 6-7.
Friday: RPE 9 is too high for a deload week, should be capped at 6-7.

cases.name: bad_no_rest_days
cases.description: Seven straight training days, zero rest, on a maintain week
issues_found: Seven consecutive training days without rest, increasing injury risk and not aligning with recovery recommendations for 'amber' fatigue level.
Sunday's session focuses on arm isolation exercises, which may not align with the primary goal of strength development.
